sections.content: You know *primero* and *además* from A2 Unit 28, *por eso* from A2 Unit 5 and *sin embargo* from B1 Unit 1. A cultural review moves from description to evaluation and recommendation, and these connectors link the steps. *En mi opinión* introduces your own judgement.

items.spanish: Primero, la película presenta una historia sencilla pero eficaz.
items.english: First, the film presents a simple but effective story.

items.spanish: Además, los personajes están bien desarrollados.
items.english: Furthermore, the characters are well developed.

items.spanish: Sin embargo, algunas escenas son demasiado largas.
items.english: However, some scenes are too long.

items.spanish: En mi opinión, merece la pena verla.
items.english: In my opinion, it is worth seeing.

sections.content: Put the steps in order for your reader: first what the work is, then what you think of it, and last whether you recommend it.
